scenarios.name: Retain the Marking Menu tab when customization is reopened from Tools

scenario_steps.name: the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab with no pending edits
a part with an active sketch is open in the MCAD Software
the user closes the customization dialog
the user opens Customize again from the Tools Options panel
the customization dialog opens on the Marking Menu tab
the user closes the customization dialog
